verdict.rationale: LangSmith's alerts docs describe threshold-based alerting on Errors, Cost, and Feedback Score, which covers eval-score drops since online evaluators write feedback scores on production traces. Alerts route to Slack, PagerDuty, Dynatrace, or any webhook, so the story's core is clearly delivered from first-party docs. Missing for 10: no documented email notification channel, alerts are fixed thresholds rather than spike/anomaly detection, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of alerting.
